description:
MOK Fest “Saturday   Traditional Concert”

Blazin’ Fiddles

Take the finest exponents of their native Scottish fiddle styles, the finest backing in folk music, and some of the Highlands and Islands’ famed warmth and craic… distil for over 25 years, and you get Blazin’ Fiddles!  Winners of Folk Band of the Year for 2025 they are one of the most lauded and best-loved acts of the Scottish music scene.   
Whether of the Royal Albert or highland village variety – they’ll turn it into the liveliest and warmest of hootenannies.

Beth Malcolm & Jim Malcolm

Beth is a songwriter, and singer of stories from Perth, Scotland. Beth’s music is folk-inspired, and she sings an eclectic mix of traditional Scots songs, alongside her own writing. Beth was named BBC MG ALBA Scots Singer of the Year in 2022 and 2024.

After a brief hiatus from folk music in her teenage years, Beth fell in love with the old songs and music she had grown up with. She found a home, singing regular floor spots at the Glasgow Star Folk club and has been singing, arranging, playing and writing ever since.

Beth will be joined by her dad Jim Malcolm who is the ultimate Scots troubadour who travels the world with his guitar, harmonicas and d and his own masterfully crafted songs.

Alex Wotherspoon as MC

Heritage Centre, Campbeltown   

6.30pm

description:
MOK Fest “Dalriada   Connections Concert”
 
Imar, There are many reasons to be excited about new Glasgow-based five-piece Ímar – not least a line-up featuring current and former members of Mànran, Mec Lir, RURA and Talisk, whose collectively crammed trophy-cabinet includes several BBC Radio 2 Folk Awards and All-Britain/All-Ireland titles. By far the best and biggest reason, however, is how excited the band are themselves.
The band are Cork-born uilleann piper, flautist and whistle player Ryan Murphy (Mànran), fiddler Tomás Callister and bouzouki ace Adam Rhodes (Mec Lir), both from the Isle of Man, Adam Brown (Rura) on bodhrán plus Glasgow native Mohsen Amini (Talisk) on concertina.

Che Martin, is a Campbeltown born singer/songwriter has been writing songs for the past 10 years creating a catalogue of over 30 songs.   These range from indie folk rock to gentle ballads and anthemic Scottish standards with a local theme. His Lyrical style has been called Dylanesque with deep vocals likened to Johnny Cash.  Che maintains it’s just the whisky and bonfires and leave it to the listener to decide.He has a forthcoming album in 2026 and features regularly on Argyll FM.  This is Che’s debut performance at the Dalriada Connections concert with a set based on his own, local songs.

Supporting Performances
Multi-instrumentalist Lorne MacDougall is known for seamlessly integrating his sounds into movie and TV soundtracks including “Brave”, the “How to Train Your Dragon” series, cult British television shows like “Doctor Who” and Wallace and Gromit.  Scooter Muse 7 times Tennessee Valley Blue Grass Champion and 3 times Alabama State Champion on five string banjo and award winning bluegrass banjo player is joined by Jil Chambless who travels from USA to perform.  Jim Malcolm who performs on the Sat night has promised us a few songs as well

MC Ciaran Mulholland has been coming over from Northern Ireland to play fiddle and sing and this year we’ll get a few stories from him as well.  He is joined by his wife Jo on concertina.

Heritage Centre, Campbeltown   

All Ages

description:
MOK Fest “Kilkerran Survivors   Night”
 
Survivors Night

A Kilkerran Distillery sponsored event 

Slainte Davaar Allstars
The Slainte Davaar Allstars will headline this year’s Kilkerran Survivors Night. The band recruits’ new musicians each year, creating memorable performances.  With 22 new tracks each year Campbeltown’s own supergroup will close this years Festival celebrations for 2026.

Kintyre Schools Pipe Band 
We are delighted that The Kintyre Schools Pipe Band will once again perform at this year’s Kilkerran Survivors Night.  The band has played some legendary performances over the years and we are sure that this year’s performance will be one that is not to be missed.

We.R.soul
We.R.Soul return to perform this year after taking a year out in 2025.  The band have played some fantastic performances in past years at both Survivors Night and Up the Close and bring together established local musicians and fresh talent to create a sound that is powerhouse vocals, lively rhythm section and dazzling horns all fused into one.

Jim and Joanne Swan
Local duo Jim & Joanne Swan having dabbled in the music scene throughout Argyll playing an eclectic mix of covers and a smidgen of their own material as Take Two.  They have told the festival “We are looking forward to playing the renowned Survivors Night a highlight in our maturing years”.  This will be their first time playing at the festival as a duo.
 
Victoria Hall, Campbeltown 

Tickets are only available to persons who are 18 years or over.

description: We are uniting UK antifa collectives and activists to create an event with a singular function; to decimate the spoils of fascism with a weekend of celebration, talks, music and fundraising. This is an anarchist festival by definition. There is no hierarchical structure. All parties currently involved are collectively volunteering to deliver a truly special benefit event. As with all of our previous bashes, all benefits will go to Medical Aid for Palestinians.Comrade Tickets give you access for Saturday and Sunday while also contributing a donation to support the cause.Ticket prices vary, with discounted rates for Trades Hall Members and standard General Admission pricing for everyone else. info: Manchester Psych Fest, the UK's leading Psychedelic multi-venue music and arts festival will take place across various city-centre venues. Tickets to be exchanged for wristbands for the festival on the day of the event at the wristband exchange point (location tbc). Line-up subject to change. Venue capacities are based on first come first serve so please arrive early for specific acts. NHS tickets - Strictly one per NHS staff. NHS required on entry. No I.D = price difference needed to gain entry. Under 24s tickets - Official photo ID needed on entrance - passport / driving license / national ID card. DOB must be after 4/9/2001. Security -- Bag Policy: Large bags including rucksacks are not allowed. There are no facilities to leave large bags or luggage. If you really have to bring a bag - and it's preferable you don't, please make sure it's small. Only one small bag per person is permitted and it must not be bigger than A4 size. pleaseNote: Over 14s only. Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult (before 11pm). Over 18s at YES (and after 11pm at other venues). ID Required. Under 25s require ID to purchase alcohol. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies for the presale, rising to a max of 8 tickets per person and per household for the general sale. Tickets in excess of this will be cancelled.

description:
MOK Fest “Cadenhead’s Festival Ceilidh Night”

The Haggis Chasers Ceilidh Band have been performing together for over 15 years, delivering an exciting and energetic ceilidh experience to their audiences without losing their heritage and roots in Traditional Scottish Dance-Band Music. The band provide a modern ceilidh experience and contains some of Scotland’s finest Ceilidh, Scottish Dance Band and Folk musicians.  Jim Malcolm will guest with the band as singer

Archie McAllister and Friends - Sileas Sinclair, Arran McAllister and Alasdair Murray
Archie McAllister is well known to local audiences for his solo, duo and band performances at the MOK Fest having played at the very first festival with the Wee Toon Tellers.  Over the years he has played on every stage at the event and for this years Ceilidh Night concert set he will be joined by 3 fantastic musicians Sileas Sinclair on keyboard & Accordion, Arran McAllister on guitar and vocals and Alasdair Murray on percussion.  
This is the perfect band to get you on the dance floor before the main ceilidh set.

Dalriada Connections Band
Once again, The Dalriada Connections Band come together to perform at the Festival Ceilidh Night.  The group is a selection of local and visiting musicians from Northern Ireland, USA and the Pan Celtic nations who are joined by students and tutors from Campbeltown Grammar School.  
Kintyre Schools Pipe Band.

The Festival Ceilidh opens with our own award-winning pipe band, The Kintyre Schools Pipe Band The band and their dedicated tutors will once again march into the to provide a stunning performance to get the night under way.

Tickets are only available to anyone under the age of 18 if they are accompanied by an adult.

description:
Kathleen MacInnes with Mike Vass
Kathleen was born on South Uist and was brought up in a Gaelic speaking home. After a few years of TV presenting and acting jobs she became known for her voice and released two albums to critical acclaim, Gaelic singer of the year in 2006 and Album of the year 2012 at the Trad Awards she also featured on Ridley Scott's Hollywood Blockbuster Robin Hood, 2010 and more recently released her third album in 2023. Also in 2023 Kathleen headlined the festival Gaelic Night and is back due to popular demand. 

Mike Vass who will accompany Kathleen on fiddle is one of the most creative forces on the Scottish music scene.

Supporting Performances Kathleen MacInnes with Mike Vass

Norman McKinnon is a hugely popular performer at the festival Ceilidh Night and has headlined at previous Dalriada Connections and Gaelic Nights. 

Argyll Arms Hotel, Campbeltown

7pm

description:
MOK Fest - Glen Scotia West Coast Rocks Concert
 
Skipinnish

Skipinnish are a powerhouse of contemporary Scottish music and marked a remarkable voyage of 25 years in 2024. Emerging from the heart of the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the band has flourished into an iconic name in the Celtic music scene, enthralling audiences with their potent blend of traditional and modern sounds
With a new line-up for 2026 Skipinnish remains a beacon of Scottish music, continuing to inspire and entertain. This will be Skipinnish’s 4th appearance at the festival.

Heron Valley

Have remained a driving force in the new generation of Scottish folk music since their 2014 inception — a band whose powerful sound has consistently ignited stages and hearts around the world. Renowned for their exhilarating live performances featuring high-octane bagpipe and fiddle tunes backed by an unrelenting rhythm section. Their sets race from reels and jigs to evocative Scottish songs and powerful original material — all delivered with a passion that’s impossible to resist.
Showing no signs of slowing down they are guaranteed to lift the roof and leave the crowd calling for more.

Argyll Ceilidh Trail

The Argyll Ceilidh Trail is a group of young, up-and-coming musicians showcasing their music across Argyll. The musicians will be on the road for four weeks prior to the festival, visiting Inveraray, Arran, Mull, Tiree and Oban and we are delighted to have them perform at this year’s Glen Scotia West Coast Rocks Concert.  The Ceilidh Trail musicians have wowed the Friday and Saturday night audiences for the past three years so we can’t wait to hear what they have in store for us on the main stage this year

Alison M Leith will MC
 
Victoria Hall, Campbeltown 

General admission with limited seated with tables and chairs.  Come early if you want a seat
 
This event is licensed, over 16’s can attend but only if accompanied by an adult

We do not accept Print at Home tickets, Booking Confirmations, screenshots or photos of tickets. Each individual attending must present their own individual ticket at the gate to have the barcode scanned. Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Reading Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.

We do not accept Print at Home tickets, Booking Confirmations, screenshots or photos of tickets. Each individual attending must present their own individual ticket at the gate to have the barcode scanned. Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Reading Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.
pleaseNote: All unreserved standing tickets use fixed Tier Pricing. All under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over who must remain on site throughout the weekend as the under 16-year-old's guardian. No unaccompanied under 16s are allowed on site. Under 13's (12 years and under) are admitted free but must be accompanied by a paying ticket-holder aged 18 or over at all times. We do not accept any parental or supervisory duty of care or liability for any under 18s on site. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled.

We do not accept Print at Home tickets, Booking Confirmations, screenshots or photos of tickets. Each individual attending must present their own individual ticket at the gate to have the barcode scanned. Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Leeds Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age Restrictions: All under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over who must remain on site throughout the weekend as the under 16-year-old's guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. accessibility.info:
Accessible tickets for wheelchair users and
ambulant persons can be purchased through
Ticketmaster. Simply click on "Buy General
Admission Accessible Tickets" and select the
tickets needed.

G2 is located up our RED painted lane customers should be dropped off outside Lord of Fries on Sauchiehall Street and make their way up our lane, indicated with The Garage Sign & G2 painted on the road.

Booths that run down the side of half of the hall can be reserved if you can't stand for the duration of the gig due to medical reasons (Limited Number Available). Please contact access@hfents.com to arrange a booth.
If you are a wheelchair user who is attending a G2 show, please contact access@hfents.com to arrange early entry into the venue. Unfortunately, all wheelchair users must remain on the floor due to the booths size and being raised onto a step

Venue stewards are more than happy to assist with any special requirements

description:
Re-Sound Festival

  
The Brook in collaboration with the Society of St James and SOCO Music are pleased to bring you the first Resound Festival 
The aim of this event is to help raise awareness to the growing homeless and those suffering with addiction in the City. 
The event will host a number of bands and live speakers among many special guests to be announced, We will also have food vendors and a festival style day with plenty going on throughout the day to keep you entertained.

accessibility.info:
Tynemouth Priory and Castle (NE30 4BZ) is accessed from it's main entrance on Front Street, Tynemouth.
Before the gates open, attendees are asked to queue downhill on Pier Road.
Accessible ticketholders do not have to queue and should approach the box office area after gates open for admission.
The venue features a tarmac driveway to a short length of cobbled pavement before moving into a hard gravel path and grass.
The festival has a viewing platform for up to 12 people and places are available on a first-come first-served basis.
An accessible ticket does not guarantee access to the platform.

Anyone wishing to discuss their individual access requirements or has any questions about the event can email events@northtyneside.gov.uk.
Parking is very limited in Tynemouth and there are no dedicated spaces for the concerts.
The nearest Metro station is Tynemouth.

description:
Tortoise is widely considered one of the most influential music groups of the last 40 years, with a wide-reaching impact on the contemporary music scene. Pitchfork says: “Imagine a graphic showing all the bands the five members of Tortoise were in before they came together and then all the bands they went on to play with after. At the top of the funnel you have groups ranging from dreamy psych-rock to earthy post-punk crunch, including Eleventh Dream Day, Bastro, Slint, and the Poster Children; on the 'post-Tortoise' end are groups focusing on electro-jazz and twangy instrumental rock like Isotope 217, Chicago Underground, and Brokeback. In this graphic, Tortoise is the choke point, the one project that has elements of all these sounds but is never defined by nor committed to any of them. Instead, Tortoise floats free, a planchette moving over a Ouija board guided by 10 sets of fingers, where everyone watches the arrow float in one direction but no one is quite sure how it gets there or who is doing the pushing.”.

Initially hailed as pace-setters of the then-emerging, so-called “post-rock” sound (a wording band never have really been happy with), the Chicago Tribune called Tortoise’s sound “mood music that refuses to be shoved into the background, as inviting as it is challenging.”

Releasing just seven albums since 1990 — including classics like 1996’s Millions Now Living Will Never Die, 1998’s TNT, and 2001’s Standards —Tortoise has steadily and intuitively evolved across its life, creating genreless music that is as timeless as it is ahead of the curve. The band’s legacy goes beyond its recorded output, as well. Per the New York Times: “While Tortoise's albums have experimented with the editing and overdubbing possibilities of the studio, the band thrives performing in real time.” Rolling Stone deems Tortoise “a live marvel,” while Pitchfork further says the band’s performances reveal that “at heart, they’re a supremely fun band, wide open to all sorts of sonic possibilities.”

Ages 14+ (Under 16s to be accompanied by an adult 18+)

Please note that tickets are sold as Ground Floor Standing and Balcony Unreserved Seating respectively. Standing ticket holders may not access the Balcony area and vice versa.

We welcome anyone with accessibility requirements and will endeavour to accommodate any needs you may have. Please get in touch prior to making a booking by emailing support@hackney.church
 
About Hackney Church
Located in the heart of East London, Hackney Church, officially known as St John at Hackney, is the historic parish church of Hackney, dating back to 1792. Today, the church is part of SAINT, a thriving church meeting across multiple East London locations. Following a multi-million-pound restoration, part-funded by the National Lottery Heritage Fund, the church has undergone a substantial transformation, driven by a vision to create a 'cathedral of creativity' to serve the local community and beyond. This project was spearheaded by an acclaimed team including world-renowned minimalist architect John Pawson CBE, visual artist Es Devlin, and conservation experts Thomas Ford & Partners. The renovation not only improved the church’s accessibility but also meticulously preserved its historical integrity, establishing it as an impressive centre for community engagement. Hackney Church functions as a premier venue for live music, arts and culture, intertwined with Hackney's cultural and social landscape.

About Lighthouse
Lighthouse is the dedicated social outreach arm of SAINT, started in 2016 to provide support and services to local people in need across East London. Supported by hundreds of volunteers, and funded by community donations, grants and live shows at Hackney Church, Lighthouse provides holistic support to individuals and families in need, spanning a range of services designed to combat poverty, homelessness, loneliness and social exclusion. Key initiatives have included a food bank that has distributed almost half a million meals since 2020, the provision of delicious hot community meals in partnership with restaurant Moro, and comprehensive homeless outreach that provides essential support services and signposting. Lighthouse also engages in extensive community support efforts, employment assistance, finance courses, and skills development workshops, all aimed at helping those in crisis and pointing towards a hope-filled future.

description:
EVERGREY, Gothenburg’s masterminds of melancholia, offer up another outburst of beautiful darkness 
and turn their inner fire into something unstoppable: their intense fifteenth album, Architects Of A 
New Weave, will be released on June 5, 2026 via Napalm Records, just days before the band takes the 
stage as special guest to the undisputed kings of heavy metal, Iron Maiden, for two shows on their Run 
For Your Lives World Tour.
This is the wake-up call you didn’t know you needed: a plunge into thinning air, burning worlds, and 
lingering guilt—only to break free with fierce momentum. The album refuses to wallow. It ascends—
fast, heavy, and cinematic. But it refuses to hide in the dark. It rises: fast, fierce, and utterly 
transformative. Among other exclusive formats, Architects Of A New Weave comes with a bonus 
album, containing bonus tracks “Heights” and “One Heart”, as well as an album mix of the previously 
released standalone single “OXYGEN!” (2025). Additionally, it features a demo version of “Longing”, 
instrumental tracks of “Leaving The Emptiness”, both new songs, as well as a live version of “Falling 
From The Sun”, the hit single off the previous record, Theories of Emptiness (2024) and continuation 
of “Ominous” off of A Heartless Portrait (The Orphean Testament) (2022). 
Dive into Architects Of A New Weave’s standout tracks like “The World is on Fire”, “Leaving The 
Emptiness”, “Heaven”, and “The Prophecy”, and the breathtaking title anthem “Architects Of The New 
Weave”. Their choruses break through like sunlight piercing storm clouds: enormous, cinematic 
melodies that pull you upward, riffs with genuine weight and bite, and vocals dripping with raw, 
unflinching truth. In one breath, you’re shouldering buried longing; in the next, you’re weightless, 
fearless, endless. Scars transform into badges of survival, fractures fuel reinvention. In the second half 
of the album, fellow Gothenburg icon Mikael Stanne (Dark Tranquillity, The Halo Effect, Grand Cadaver, 
Cemetery Skyline) joins Tom S. Englund in vocal duties for “A Burning Flame”, the voices of the two 
scene legends intertwined compellingly. Architects Of A New Weave was produced by Tom S. Englund 
and Vikram Shankar, with a stellar mix by Adam "Nolly" Getgood.
Chaos doesn’t claim victory—you do. You step forward as the weaver, rethreading belief, identity, 
connection, and the very shape of tomorrow into something stronger, brighter, unbreakable. This is 
melodic, progressive, dark metal at its most massive and intimate: heavy enough to shift mountains, 
anthemic enough to make you raise your fist and truly believe it. It carries one unshakable truth 
straight to your core: Nothing—not pain, not darkness, not any storm—gets to label you broken. You’re 
the power that gathers the fragments and forges real beauty from them. Dream weavers rising. 
Architects are stepping up to claim what comes next. If you’ve ever felt that inner tug—quiet or 
roaring—to rewrite your story on your own terms, with zero apologies and complete ownership, this 
is the soundtrack that turns the urge into certainty. Your battle cry. Your hymn for renewal, creation, 
and finally stepping into the person you’re destined to be. Whether it launches EVERGREY’s boldest 
era yet, stands as a fierce standalone declaration, or serves as the pivotal bridge chapter that redefines 
their path, Architects Of A New Weave is pure cinematic motivation—ready to charge your playlist 
and propel your momentum forward. It’s as though EVERGREY don’t merely survive adversity—they 
rise and expand because of it. Every challenge, every setback, every wound seems to become the 
very oxygen that fuels their music. The darker the storm that once threatened to break them, the more 
powerfully each note draws breath from that same pain, transforming what hurt them yesterday into 
the soaring, living heart of their songs today. Architects Of A New Weave seals it: we are no longer 
victims of the night, but creators of new skies, new beliefs, and entirely new heavens. Grab it now. Let 
it arm you. This isn’t just an album – it’s the sound of you seizing control and building what’s next.

description:
Terminal V Festival 2027 marks the next chapter in the evolution of Terminal V, launching a brand-new outdoor festival experience in Glasgow.

As Terminal V celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2027, the event expands with its first-ever fully outdoor festival in Scotland – a landmark moment for one of Europe's leading electronic music brands.

Industrial aesthetics have always been at the heart of Terminal V's identity, making this move to a new inner-city industrial location a natural progression for the festival. The site will provide a unique multi-stage outdoor experience in the heart of Glasgow, blending the raw energy of the city's industrial heritage with world-class production and cutting-edge electronic music.

Full venue details will be revealed soon, with the first artist announcement set to follow later this year.

info: Weekend + Early Entry Tickets are valid for campsite entry from Noon on Wednesday 26th August 2026. Leeds Festival Tickets are only valid when purchased directly from official agents of Festival Republic. We do not accept Print at Home tickets, Booking Confirmations, screenshots or photos of tickets. Each individual attending must present their own individual ticket at the gate to have the barcode scanned. Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Leeds Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.
pleaseNote: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder over 18 who must remain on site throughout the weekend as the under 16-year-old's guardian. No unaccompanied under 16s are allowed on site. Under 13's (12 years and under) are admitted free, without a ticket, but must be accompanied by a paying ticket-holder aged 18 or over at all times (maximum 2 children per adult) We do not accept any parental or supervisory duty of care or liability for any under 18s on site. If you want to arrive before 3am on Thursday 27/08/26 you must purchase a "Weekend Ticket Plus Early Entry Pass" If you want to arrive after 3am on Thursday 27/08/26 you are OK to purchase a "Weekend Ticket. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled.

Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Reading Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.

accessibility.info:
Patrons requiring a hearing induction system or other services (BSL/Audio Description etc) should contact the venue.
Wheelchair Accessible are for wheelchair users.
Mobility Accessible, or 'Ambulant' positions, are for patrons with conditions that make it difficult to climb stairs. These seats are usually accessible with no steps, but some are reached by between 2 and 14 steps. If you wish to clarify any seating arrangement, please contact the venue.
Companion Tickets allow one free companion ticket for each accessible ticket purchased. If you need more than one essential companion or additional positions in your booking, please contact the venue.
By purchasing an accessible ticket with a companion ticket, you’ll be required to provide proof of eligibility/disability before the event. You will be contacted by Ticketmaster no later than 72 hours after your order. Failure to provide evidence may result in your tickets being cancelled.

description:
The 1865 Presents

Solent Area Prog Festival    

Saturday
EBB 
A theatrical art-rock band rapidly gaining popularity with their song driven brand of Prog.
Cephid
The latest project from Moray Macdonald includes a LASER harp. Moray is best known as keyboardist with Rammlied (Rammstein tribute) and That Joe Payne. 
That Joe Payne
The ex-Enid vocalist with a huge vocal range.
The Wood Demons
A very popular band for whom I]we get many requests to bring back. Prog with a fiddle!
Colin Masson 
A rare performance from the former guitarist with Progressive Folk-Rock band The Morrigan performing solo guitar in front of his videos on screen
The Hayley Griffiths Band -Unplugged.
One of the most versatile vocalists (Ex-Karnataka and Riverdance)  Unique for this festival she has an opportunity to show her gentler side.

description:
The 1865 Presents

Solent Area Prog Festival    
  
Saturday
EBB 
A theatrical art-rock band rapidly gaining popularity with their song driven brand of Prog.
Cephid
The latest project from Moray Macdonald includes a LASER harp. Moray is best known as keyboardist with Rammlied (Rammstein tribute) and That Joe Payne. 
That Joe Payne
The ex-Enid vocalist with a huge vocal range.
The Wood Demons
A very popular band for whom I]we get many requests to bring back. Prog with a fiddle!
Colin Masson 
A rare performance from the former guitarist with Progressive Folk-Rock band The Morrigan performing solo guitar in front of his videos on screen
The Hayley Griffiths Band -Unplugged.
One of the most versatile vocalists (Ex-Karnataka and Riverdance)  Unique for this festival she has an opportunity to show her gentler side.
 
Sunday
Lee Abraham Band 
Playing their only UK gig in 2026. If we are lucky Peter Jones will join Lee for a few guest vocals
Tiger Moth Tales (solo) 
Peter Jones multi-instrumentalist with Camel sings some of his own compositionss. 
Kepler Ten 
The reformed original line-up return.
Galahad 
With something unique planned for this event
Martin Orford  
(Jadis, Ex-IQ and John Wetton band). A rare solo perfromance

Solent Area Prog Festival  
 
Sunday
Lee Abraham Band

Peter Jones multi-instrumentalist with Camel sings some of his own compositionss.

The reformed original line-up return.
Galahad 
With something unique planned for this event
Martin Orford 
(Jadis, Ex-IQ and John Wetton band). A rare solo perfromance

info: Weekend Tickets are valid for campsite entry from 6pm on Wednesday 19th August 2026. Reading Festival Tickets are only valid when purchased directly from official agents of Festival Republic. We do not accept Print at Home tickets, Booking Confirmations, screenshots or photos of tickets. Each individual attending must present their own individual ticket at the gate to have the barcode scanned. Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Reading Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.
pleaseNote: All under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over who must remain on site throughout the weekend as the under 16-year-old's guardian. No unaccompanied under 16s are allowed on site. Under 13s (12 years and under) are admitted free but must be accompanied by a paying ticket-holder aged 18 or over at all times. It is the responsibility of the adult(s) to determine the correct ratio of supervising adults to under 18s, taking into account the age, needs and abilities of the children, the nature of the Event and any applicable guidelines. We do not act in any parental or supervisory capacity for under 18s on site. This does not affect our legal duties to any attendee in respect of, or obligation to comply with, any applicable laws including health and safety or licensing laws. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled.

info: General Admission Only This ticket is for Friday and Sunday Day Admission Only. Reading Festival Tickets are only valid when purchased directly from official agents of Festival Republic. We do not accept Print at Home tickets, Booking Confirmations, screenshots or photos of tickets. Each individual attending must present their own individual ticket at the gate to have the barcode scanned. Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. Wristbands removed from the wrist, cut or tampered with will be rendered invalid and will not be replaced. Reading Festival will not replace lost or stolen wristbands regardless of proof of purchase.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. Under 13s go free with an adult 18+. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled. Fixed Tier Pricing means the Event Organiser is selling tickets in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option.

description:
This summer, Cafe Mambo Ibiza brings the ultimate Ibiza festival experience to Reading as Mambo In The Park lands at Prospect Park, Berkshire on Saturday 15th August 2026!

Known worldwide for its legendary Ibiza sunset parties and world-class DJs, the iconic brand is returning to the UK with one of the biggest Cafe Mambo Ibiza events of the year. Expect huge festival production, a vibrant open-air atmosphere, and a star-studded line-up of Ibiza DJs and performers delivering a true slice of the White Isle right in the heart of Reading.

Following the success of previous events across the UK, Cafe Mambo Ibiza Classics In The Park is back bigger and better for 2026. Fans can look forward to enhanced stage production, expanded VIP areas and an even bigger line-up, bringing the unmistakable Ibiza party energy to Prospect Park.

If you love, Ibiza anthems and outdoor summer festivals, this is set to be one of the standout music events in Reading this summer.

Festival event times 12pm - 10:00pm (final entry time is 7pm) 

Travel to the festival:  

Train: Reading West- 1.3 miles from Prospect Park Reading Station - 2.6 miles from Prospect Park The fast Elizabeth Line runs a direct service from London to Reading in just 50 mins 

Bus:  
Reading west is located approximately 1.3 miles from Prospect Park 

Various local taxi companies & Uber operate in the area to and from main stations. 
Food or drink are not permitted to be brought into the festival site. There are various bars and food vendors on the site that you can purchase refreshments from. Pets are not permitted onto the festival site.  

Line up and timings are subject to change. 
This event is 18+  

VIP tickets include: Fast track entry + access to large VIP area / bar + luxury toilets

 For carer tickets please email us for more information: info@screamlouderevents.com

description:
The Great Escape Festival 2027
Various venues across Brighton

Delegate passes are for over 18's only. 
 
The Great Escape returns in 2027 as the world's leading festival for new music and the global meeting point for the music industry. Taking over Brighton for four days, the event brings together 450+ emerging artists alongside a forward-thinking conference featuring the brightest minds from across live, recording and digital sectors.
A delegate pass gives you access to the full conference programme, networking events, and priority entry to festival showcases putting you at the heart of where new talent is discovered, and the future of music is shaped. Whether you’re looking to build connections, discover your next signing, or stay ahead of industry trends, The Great Escape is where it all happens

About

The new all day indie festival brought to you by Feeling Gloomy, Old School Indie, Afternoon of Indie and Age Against The Machine, featuring live tributes from: 

The InCureables (The Cure)

Echoes of the Bunnymen (Echo & The Bunnymen)

Laid (James)

Pet Shop Boys Actually (Pet Shop Boys)

Plus party sets all day from Feeling Gloomy and Old School Indie DJs

description:
🔥 Imagine This... 🔥 
A place where the sizzle of the grill meets the energy of a buzzing crowd, where smoky aromas fill the air, and the rhythm of live music creates the perfect backdrop. Each bite is more than just food—it’s a story, an experience, a moment to savor and remember.

This year, we’re turning up the heat ,with a whole new pitmasters and live fire chef crew who will being bringing thier vibrant flavors and energy straight to you! Think mouthwatering  currys, tacos, tequila cocktails that pack a punch, and a fiesta atmosphere that’s second to none. 

And if that’s not enough, brace yourself for the excitement of the British Open Freestyle BBQ Championships™ Top teams from the UK and Europe will go head-to-head in an electrifying competition, demonstrating unmatched skill and creativity as they strive to perfect their BBQ masterpieces. Plus enter the uk's biggest hotdog eating contest with 
With over eight mouthwatering categories to experience, there’s no shortage of incredible flavors to enjoy. This is an event you and your f\mily  simply can’t miss! 🔥🍖 

 🔥 Experience the Embers Lounge, hosted by Chef James Peck of the award-winning Ember Restaurant — where true culinary magic awaits. 🔥 

Step into an exclusive dining experience like no other. With just 30 seats per session, the Embers Lounge offers an intimate setting for an unforgettable culinary journey.

Indulge in a 4-course tasting menu perfectly paired with drinks, all crafted by world-class fire chefs from the UK, Southeast Asia, the USA, and South America. This isn’t just a meal—it’s a feast for the senses, showcasing the finest flavors and techniques from around the globe.

🌟 Limited availability—book your seat now and experience LIve Fire dinning redefined!

At the Smoke and Fire Festival, we don’t just celebrate BBQ—we create a community of food lovers, fun-seekers, and adventurers who know that life’s best moments are meant to be shared.

🔥 This is your invitation to join us and experience the sights, smells, tastes, and sounds that make this festival the ultimate summer event.

Don’t just imagine it—be there. Secure your tickets today and be part of the flavor, the fun, and the fire!

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
On Saturday 15 August, Funky Dory Festival 7.0 returns to Ashfields Carriage & Polo Club in Essex for a full day of soul, disco, soulful house and party classics.

This is a boutique summer festival built for people who really love the music. Set in the beautiful Essex countryside. With a proper community vibe.

This year’s line-up includes Michael Gray, Mark Knight, John Morales, Colin Francis, Gordon Mac MBE, Noah Herel and Good 4 Tha Soul with Ronnie Herel, Brandon Block, Bobby & Steve and Ricky Morrison.

PLUS a live PA from the wonderful Haifa.

Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. It is prohibited to resell tickets for the Event, except where resold using the official resale platform of the official ticket agent you purchased from, in accordance with the relevant ticket agent's resale terms and conditions. Tickets purchased from unauthorised sources may be rendered invalid and admission refused. Tickets must be valid, presented in full according to the authorised agents delivery methods and not altered or tampered with.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. The Event is not suitable for young children. Children under 13 (Aged 12 or below) are NOT permitted. All under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over who must remain on site throughout the Event as the under 16-year-old's guardian. No unaccompanied under 16s are allowed on site. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled. Last entry times - Friday 20:00 Saturday 20:00 Sunday 19:30

description:
It is with great pleasure that we can announce the ChippStock Festival will return in 2027 once again in the gardens of Blackwells in Chipperfield on Bank Holiday Sunday 30 May 2027!
There will be amazing live music and DJs across the whole day, featuring one of the UKs most popular tribute bands, alongside a selection of other amazing artists.
A fully stocked bar will be available from Blackwells and a selection of food vendors for you to choose from across the day!

Profits will be donated to Friend Of St Pauls School (PTA)

Tickets for this event have a unique barcode which will be scanned on entry and if found to be duplicated, either in error or for fraudulent gain, only the first instance of the ticket scanned will be admitted regardless of original ownership. Customers may be prosecuted if found to have deliberately duplicated and resold tickets for fraudulent gain. It is prohibited to resell tickets for the Event, except where resold using the official resale platform of the official ticket agent you purchased from, in accordance with the relevant ticket agent's resale terms and conditions. Tickets purchased from unauthorised sources may be rendered invalid and admission refused. Tickets must be valid, presented in full according to the authorised agents delivery methods and not altered or tampered with.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. The Event is not suitable for young children. Children under 13 (Aged 12 or below) are NOT permitted. All under 16s must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder aged 18 or over who must remain on site throughout the Event as the under 16-year-old's guardian. No unaccompanied under 16s are allowed on site. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled. Last entry times - Friday 20:00 Saturday 20:00 Sunday 19:30

accessibility.info:
To apply for the use of Accessible Facilities at the event, please submit a Wireless Festival Accessible Facilities Application Form. Full information about the facilities that are provided, and the application process, can be found on the Wireless Festival Accessibility Information Page. 

To apply for use of the accessible facilities, please visit our website (https://wirelessfestival.co.uk/info-category/accessibility), and follow the instructions available there.

Please do not buy a ticket for your essential companion. These are allocated through the application process.

Service hours:
For any queries regarding accessibility please do not hesitate to email the team at accessibility@wirelessfestival.co.uk. The inbox is monitored between 10am and 6pm, Monday to Friday. We aim to respond within 5 working days

info: Bridges for Music is a non-profit organization harnessing the power of music to drive positive change in underserved communities. Founded in South Africa, the organization empowers young creatives through education, entrepreneurship, and access to the global music industry. With its pioneering Music and Entrepreneurship Academy in Langa, Cape Town, Bridges for Music provides students with holistic development-from music production and business training to mindfulness and wellness practices. The organization has worked with global artists like Skrillex, Richie Hawtin, Black Coffee and Martin Garrix is supported by brands such as Alpha Theta, Resident Advisor, and Nando's. At it's core, Bridges for Music believes in creating a more inclusive and connected world through cultural exchange, creative expression, and equal opportunity. Information regarding your order will be e-mailed. If your email address changes, please let us know. There is NO EVENT TICKET included
pleaseNote: This summer, Bridges for Music is hosting a chaperoned cycle ride from London to Wilderness Festival-a powerful fusion of movement, music, and mission. Fuelled by Music, Riding for Education. Limited to a select group of riders, this unique journey offers not only a sustainable and memorable way to arrive at the festival but also a chance to support creative education initiatives for underserved youth in South Africa

info: Weekend Non-Camping Tickets - Gives you access to the arena only on Friday 18th, Saturday 19th and Sunday 20th June 2027. Please Note: This ticket DOES NOT inlcude access to the campervan field or any other campsite. There is strictly no overnight stay or camping in the car parks. Weekend Non-Camping Tickets (With VIP Area Access) - Includes exclusive access to VIP bar & chill out area in the arena. Also includes access to Main Stage Grandstand, this is un-reserved seating and all seats are on a first come first served basis. General Admission tickets and tickets 'With VIP Area Access' cannot be purchased in the same booking. If you wish to purchase a teen or child ticket, this must be the same type as the Adult Ticket.

accessibility.info:
Accessibility customers should buy a Weekend Camping, Weekend Non-Camping, or relevant Day Ticket. Please note there is no separate Accessibility ticket type. 

Full information about the accessible facilities available at the event (including Essential Companion tickets), and how to apply for them, can be found on the State Fayre Accessibility Information page (opens in new tab).

If you wish to stay in a Campervan/Caravan in the Accessibility Campsite, please do not buy a standard Campervan/Caravan Ticket or Pitch as this will not be transferable to the Accessibility Campsite. You will be able to apply for an Accessibility Campervan pass as part of your application to use the accessible facilities.

info: New for 2027 we have introduced a Mini moshers event ticket, so you no longer need to apply to camp in this campsite. Just select the 3- or 5-night camping - Mini Moshers ticket on Ticketmaster. Please note, these tickets are only available with a child ticket or under 5's ticket attached to the order. Please ensure all event tickets are included when booking Mini Moshers, as we cannot guarantee availability for tickets added after the initial booking. If you want to stay in the Mini moshers campsite, please booked a 3/5 Night Camping - Mini Mosher camping ticket. 5 Night Camping Tickets give you access to campsites from Wednesday 9th June until Monday 14th June 2027 and access to the arena on all show days, you will also have access to District X 3 Night Camping Tickets give you access to campsites from Friday 11th June until Monday 14th June 2027 and access to the arena on all show days, you will also have access to District X.
pleaseNote: Age Restrictions: - Under 5s (ages 0-4 years) are allowed for free - under 5's ticket required, but must be accompanied by a ticket-holding adult. - 5-12-year-olds must be accompanied by a ticket-holding adult over 18, and each child will require a Child Ticket. - 13-15 years old must purchase an ADULT ticket and be accompanied by a parent/guardian over 18. - 16-17-year-olds must purchase an ADULT ticket however do not need to be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over. Note: Download Festival will contain acts unsuitable for children. Parents may be asked to provide ID with proof of age if the child appears to be over 12 but holding a Child Ticket. Don't take any chances - bring proof of age. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled.

info: General Admission Campervan / Caravan (Event Ticket) & Campervan / Caravan (Vehicle) Pass 5 Night Campervan / Caravan (Event) Tickets give you access to the Campervan Field from Wednesday 9th June until Monday 14th June 2027 and access to the arena on all show days, you will also have access to District X. 3 Night Camping Tickets give you access to the Campervan Field from Friday 11th June until Monday 14th June 2027 and access to the arena on all show days, you will also have access to District X. You can not access the Campervan Field with a Weekend Arena ticket. District x only accessible via shuttle bus outside of arena hours. Campervan campsite location for 2027 TBC
pleaseNote: Campervan / Caravan (Vehicle) Passes are now sold out. New for 2027 all guests staying in the Campervan / Caravan Campsite will need to purchase a 3 or 5 night camping (Event Ticket). Age Restrictions: Under 5s (ages 0-4 years) are allowed for free - under 5's ticket required but must be accompanied by a ticket-holding adult. 5-12-year-olds must be accompanied by a ticket-holding adult over 18, and each child will require a Child Ticket. 13-15 years old must purchase an ADULT ticket and be accompanied by a parent/guardian over 18. 16-17-year-olds must purchase an ADULT ticket however do not need to be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over. Note: Download Festival will contain acts unsuitable for children. Parents may be asked to provide ID with proof of age if the child appears to be over 12 but holding a Child Ticket. Don't take any chances - bring proof of age. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled.

info: Airstream includes: - Electricity - Lockable - Bed linen and towels - Fully fitted kitchen including fridge/freezer, crockery and cooking utensils - Lounge area - Toilet and bathroom with shower and mirror - Central heating - Air-con - TV/DVD (due to the location & nature of the event, TV signal may be poor) - Surround sound, iPod connector, USB Exact details & bed layouts vary, after purchasing you will be contacted by VIP Nation to select a specific Aistream. Please note it is not possible to secure 4 or 5 single beds in any Airstream. Dimensions - Doorway width & height: 66cm width, 165cm height - Threshold height off ground level: 60cm from floor to threshold height Accessibilty guidance: may not be accessible to wheelchair users due to step up and narrow doorway.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. Under 5s free. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. Your RIP Metal Meadow 1 purchase also includes: - RIP Weekend festival ticket to Download - Car parking in the nearby Metal Car Park 1 (10 mins walk, shuttle available) (1 pass per 3 guests) - Guest Area weekend access -RIP's 'Doggie' bag -Access to RIP Village -RIP entertainment, live performances, DJ's & quiz night Please see the booking information for full RIP description.

pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. Under 5s free. A max of 6 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 6 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. The Rock Retreat is situated in the grounds of Melbourne Hall, campers will have access to a maximum pitch size of 22msq per person. Every person must have a Rock Retreat ticket to stay in the campsite, inc children. Accompanied Under 5s are allowed for free. The last Shuttle Bus service from the festival back to Rock Retreat will be half an hour after the main arena closes.

accessibility.info:
If you have any specific accessibility requirements or concerns, please contact VIP Nation at Download@VIPNation.co.uk

Please be aware that due to a high level of interest in our RIP packages, we cannot guarantee availability of your preferred package.

All accessibility customers and their companions should ensure they have an RIP ticket, whether they're staying in Park Farm, Sleepy Hollow, Thunder Valley, Metal Meadow accommodation or RIP Hotel Package. Once accessibility applications open & approvals for Essential Companions are granted, a partial refund for the amount of the festival ticket included in the package will be processed.

Please note the type of ticket included in RIP packages is a Weekend Arena Only ticket. Partial refunds for Essential Companions will reflect the face value of the ticket at the time your RIP booking was made. 

Live Nation and VIP Nation will use their reasonable efforts to assist with any such special accessibility requirements or concerns.

If you have any specific accessibility requirements or concerns, please contact VIP Nation at Download@VIPNation.co.uk

Please be aware that due to a high level of interest in our RIP packages, we cannot guarantee availability of your preferred package.

All accessibility customers and their companions should ensure they have an RIP ticket, whether they're staying in Park Farm, Sleepy Hollow, Thunder Valley, Metal Meadow accommodation or RIP Hotel Package. Once accessibility applications open & approvals for Essential Companions are granted, a partial refund for the amount of the festival ticket included in the package will be processed.

Please note the type of ticket included in RIP packages is a Weekend Arena Only ticket. Partial refunds for Essential Companions will reflect the face value of the ticket at the time your RIP booking was made. 

Live Nation and VIP Nation will use their reasonable efforts to assist with any such special accessibility requirements or concerns.

accessibility.info:
If you have any specific accessibility requirements or concerns, please contact VIP Nation at Download@VIPNation.co.uk
Please be aware that due to a high level of interest in our RIP packages, we cannot guarantee availability of your preferred package.
All accessibility customers and their companions should ensure they have an RIP ticket, whether they're staying in Park Farm, Sleepy Hollow, Thunder Valley, Metal Meadow accommodation or RIP Hotel Package. Once accessibility applications open & approvals for Essential Companions are granted, a partial refund for the amount of the festival ticket included in the package will be processed.
Please note the type of ticket included in RIP packages is a Weekend Arena Only ticket. Partial refunds for Essential Companions will reflect the face value of the ticket at the time your RIP booking was made. 
Live Nation and VIP Nation will use their reasonable efforts to assist with any such special accessibility requirements or concerns.

If you have any specific accessibility requirements or concerns, please contact VIP Nation at Download@VIPNation.co.uk

Please be aware that due to a high level of interest in our RIP packages, we cannot guarantee availability of your preferred package.

All accessibility customers and their companions should ensure they have an RIP ticket, whether they're staying in Park Farm, Sleepy Hollow, Thunder Valley, Metal Meadow accommodation or RIP Hotel Package. Once accessibility applications open & approvals for Essential Companions are granted, a partial refund for the amount of the festival ticket included in the package will be processed.

Please note the type of ticket included in RIP packages is a Weekend Arena Only ticket. Partial refunds for Essential Companions will reflect the face value of the ticket at the time your RIP booking was made. 

Live Nation and VIP Nation will use their reasonable efforts to assist with any such special accessibility requirements or concerns.

info: Cabin for 4 includes: - Power supply (1 socket & 3 USB ports - for charging devices only) - Wooden stable door with lock - Wooden flooring with carpet - Canvas roof and sides - Camp bunk beds with canvas base - Pillows - Throw per person - LED light - Porch with lantern - Small mirror - 1 bedside table - 4 folding chairs Dimensions: 3.8m x 2.5m - Doors are 186cm high and 58cm wide - Porch includes step of approximately 10cm up from ground. Accessibility Guidance: Accessible for some wheelchair users, please note the dimensions of the doorway.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age Restrictions: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. PRICE DISPLAYED IS PER STRUCTURE NOT PER PERSON. Festival Tickets are not included in your accommodation price & must be booked separately. Everyone staying in your Latitude Luxury accommodation must have a Weekend Camping ticket to gain entry. Before purchasing, please review the important booking information link in the Event Info section below.

pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age Restrictions: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 1 ticket per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 1 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. PRICE DISPLAYED IS PER STRUCTURE NOT PER PERSON. Festival Tickets are not included in your accommodation price & must be booked separately. Everyone staying in your Latitude Luxury accommodation must have a Weekend Camping ticket to gain entry. Before purchasing, please review the important booking information link in the Event Info section below.

info: Don't fancy the faff of bringing and pitching your own tent? Unfurnished, pre-pitched accommodation, so all you need to do is arrive ready to enjoy the festival. Empty Bell for up to 5 or 8 includes: - All tents come empty. No beds are included. Please bring all your own cushions & bedding. - You can sleep up to 5/8 people in this tent, though of course, fewer campers means more space for your glad rags! Only the advertised number of people for your tent size can stay in the accommodation. Final products are subject to minor changes from advertised pictures, depending on exact availability. Dimensions: Up to 5 - 5m diameter, 3m central height - Doorway width & height: 3.65m x 1.85m - Threshold height off ground level: 0.1m Up to 8 - 6m diameter x 4m central height - Doorway width & height: 3.65m x 1.85m - Threshold height off ground level: 0.1m Please note, these tents do not include electric. Accessibility Guidance: Accessible to many wheelchair users.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age Restrictions: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 4 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 4 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. PRICE DISPLAYED IS PER STRUCTURE NOT PER PERSON. Festival Tickets are not included in your accommodation price & must be booked separately. Everyone staying in your Latitude Luxury accommodation must have a Weekend Camping ticket to gain entry. Before purchasing, please review the important booking information link in the Event Info section below.

info: RV for up to 4 or 8 includes: - Electricity - Lockable - All bedding and towels provided - Combination of pull-out beds / bunk beds - Toilet(s) and wash basins, shower - Running hot water - Air Conditioning and heating Lounge Area - TV with Freeview channels Kitchen - Cooking facilities, microwave, kettle & toaster - Pots / Pans / Cups / Glassware, cutlery and utensils - Large fridge/freezer - Large sink Bedroom(s) - TV with Freeview channels - Storage Please note: Exact details, dimensions & bed layouts vary. pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age Restrictions: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 1 ticket per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 1 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option. PRICE DISPLAYED IS PER STRUCTURE NOT PER PERSON. Festival Tickets are not included in your accommodation price & must be booked separately. Everyone staying in your Latitude Luxury accommodation must have a Weekend Camping ticket to gain entry. Before purchasing, please review the important booking information link in the Event Info section below.

info: Enjoy your festival experience in comfort and style by upgrading to the Latitude Lounge, an oasis in the heart of the festival. Take advantage of the fully serviced facilities including luxury restrooms, cloakroom, phone charging and a pamper area all included in your Lounge upgrade. Latitude Lounge upgrade includes: - Chill out area & casual seating with table service - Dedicated bar selling cocktails, champagne, beer, wine, spirits & soft drinks* - Gourmet food* - Changing facilities - Pamper area - Lounge Cloakroom Facilities*** - Phone charging - Luxury restrooms - Baby changing hub. Quiet space with travel cots, wooden toys and complimentary nappies and wipes - Commemorative wristband - Free entry to children under 13 (12 years and under) with a paying adult * at additional cost ** limited to 1 child per adult ***please note cloakroom is available on first come first served basis and may get oversubscribed in days with variable weather.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 6 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 6 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling tickets in the same category at different prices. Lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time, we recommend choosing the lower priced option. This ticket only includes The Lounge access for the day or weekend as selected, no GA Festival Tickets are included. - One The Lounge Ticket admits one person to The Latitude Lounge. - The Lounge Ticket only gives access to The Latitude Lounge, it gives no access to the Guest Area, or any Campsites. - If you have accessibility requirements, please contact us at Latitude@vipnation.co.uk

* Box office information is subject to change.

229 promotes equality of opportunity for people with disabilities and we are proud to work with Attitude is Everything, undertaking the necessary steps to meet their requirements.

Getting inside the venue

There is a doorway, which gives you access to a lift, which can take you into the basement venue. Please make yourself known to Security at the Venue entrance and they will arrange for you to be escorted into the premises. Anyone with a disability will be offered priority entry.

Inside 229

We do not have a designated viewing area, however, we do prefer to position wheelchair users directly in front of the mixing desk, which is positioned to one side. The stage is high and therefore viewing is good and there are great sight lines to the stage from any position in the venue. It is important that wheelchair users do not block any fire exits or public walkways.

Accessible Toilet & Bar

We have disabled toilets for both Venue 1 and Venue 2 on the same level as the main viewing areas. The bars are also on the same level. We also have a public bar on the ground level with another accessible toilet near the smoking area.

AGMP Presents
JANUARY BLUES FESTIVAL 2027 presents
DR. FEELGOOD
+ EDDIE & THE HOT RODS
DJ: SNOWBOY
We are thrilled to welcome British Rhythm 'n' Blues legends Dr. Feelgood along with very special guests Eddie & The Hot Rods.
Formed on Canvey Island in Essex in the early 1970's Dr. Feelgood have become one of the most popular live rhythm and blues acts in the world. Dr. Feelgood have enjoyed a string of hit singles in many countries including Milk & Alcohol, Down at the Doctors, Roxette, She's a Wind Up and See You Later Alligator.  The current line-up of the band is led by their drummer Kevin Morris, and features Gordon Russell on lead guitar, Phil Mitchell on bass and charismatic vocalist, Robert Kane. Eddie & the Hot Rods began life in 1976. They had 3 x hit albums and 4 x top forty UK singles including the Top Ten hit Do Anything You Wanna Do. They have toured alongside the Ramones, Tom Petty, The Police, Squeeze, and Talking Heads. 
Host and DJ for this incredible line up is Snowboy playing original blues 45's and more.

 This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

Electric Swing Circus bring the 1920s to the 2020s with their innovative brand of escapist pop and electro swing. Expect soaring pop vocals, intricate jazz instrumentation and pulsing, danceable electronics which feel both 100 years in the making and completely fresh. 

ESC have carved their own inimitable path over the last decade, garnering a reputation as UK festival heavyweights who broke through to the international scene, playing to huge audiences in over 20 countries. They instantly win crowds over wherever they go with their energetic performance and carefully crafted songwriting, designed to get people moving.

Their 3rd album “Pleasure Seekers” was released in March 2022 and has taken their songwriting and recorded output to yet another level with expansive songs that transport you around the world and into space, through a window of relatable self-reflection.

ESC's whirlwind of spectacular material and live performance will propel you to a dance floor somewhere between Ronnie Scott’s and the Berghain. Do not miss this!

First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets
