description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

The room in full rhythm. Two houses across the evening, each a complete Piano Bar experience built around live sets, close listening and a tightly held room.  Featuring some of the best jazz talent in the UK, presented at close range in one of Soho's most intimate live rooms.



First House: Open 6:30 PM. Two sets between 7:00 PM and 8:30 PM.  Second House: Open 8:30 PM. One late set 9:00 to 9:45 PM.  Choose your house at checkout.  Over 21s only. Photo ID required. Dress to Impress. Soho Live Music Club members receive 50% off music tickets. Check out the lineup at www.soho.live/tickets

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

Soho's first fully immersive surround sound system in Europe means you won't just watch the World Cup. You'll feel it.
Live horns. Singalong charts. Food. Great drinks. The atmosphere your living room was never going to give you.
This will sell out. Advance ticket required. Strictly limited capacity.

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

description:
Join us at the iconic Jack Solomons every Friday for London's flagship live night and  The format changes week to week: headline artists, showcase nights, and special events. It's the night that defines the week, where you discover an incredible mix of musical talent and  future stars on a premier stage.  Food is available but not included.
"Somewhere in London tonight, there is an artist the world hasn't found yet. The question is whether you'll be in the room".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

description:
Join us at the iconic Jack Solomons every Friday for London's flagship live night and  The format changes week to week: headline artists, showcase nights, and special events. It's the night that defines the week, where you discover an incredible mix of musical talent and  future stars on a premier stage.  Food is available but not included.
"Somewhere in London tonight, there is an artist the world hasn't found yet. The question is whether you'll be in the room".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

description:
Join us at the iconic Jack Solomons every Friday for London's flagship live night and  The format changes week to week: headline artists, showcase nights, and special events. It's the night that defines the week, where you discover an incredible mix of musical talent and  future stars on a premier stage.  Food is available but not included.
"Somewhere in London tonight, there is an artist the world hasn't found yet. The question is whether you'll be in the room".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Producers Playground is a weekly music night with vibey, creative energy. Live music production in the room alongside musicians who actually know how to back a freestyle. Artists building tracks in real time, shaping ideas as you watch it happen. Nothing pre-packaged. Just raw creativity unfolding on stage.

Expect jazzy house, nu-soul and hip hop, woven together by producers and players reading the room.

"Great hybrid of live musicians and beats - proper mid-week hang".

Food is available at the venue (not included with your ticket).

THE VENUE
Jack Solomon's Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history, on the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Just off Piccadilly Circus, down in that iconic basement, it’s all low lights, close tables, and a band already in full flow when you walk in. Jazz, fusion, a bit of everything — played by people who really know what they’re doing.

The lineup’s always strong, but it’s the unexpected stuff that makes it. Surprise guests turning up, musicians jumping in, things stretching out and going somewhere new. No two nights land the same.
It works as a date. It works if you’re with friends. It works if you just want to sit with a drink, grab some food and get pulled into it for a couple of hours.

"Good food, proper drinks, and a room that feels alive".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

description:
Join us at the iconic Jack Solomons every Friday for London's flagship live night and  The format changes week to week: headline artists, showcase nights, and special events. It's the night that defines the week, where you discover an incredible mix of musical talent and  future stars on a premier stage.  Food is available but not included.
"Somewhere in London tonight, there is an artist the world hasn't found yet. The question is whether you'll be in the room".

Jack Solomons Club is home of the Discovery Stage. A modern continuation of Soho's music history - the site of Club Eleven (1948), The Scene Club, and early performances by The Rolling Stones and The Who.

For all the latest information answers to FAQs about Rewind South, please visit our helpful information page here >> https://south.rewindfestival.com/ If you can't find the answer you need, feel free to contact us at admin@rewindfestival.com
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age restrictions: 18+ years require an ADULT ticket - those aged 10-17 years require a YOUTH ticket and must be with a guardian aged 21+ - children aged 0-9 years require a CHILD ticket. Please remember to bring identification to the festival if you appear under 18 and are coming to the festival without an over 21 year old, otherwise you may be denied entry to the event. Acceptable forms of identification are BLine cards, passports, driving licences and Citizenship cards. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option.

accessibility.info:
Parklife continues to work to ensure the festival is accessible for everyone attending. Please read the following page for all information on our on-site facilities.
As a promoter, Parklife provides an Essential Companion ticket scheme for individuals who would be unable to attend their events without bringing a companion. This means you only need to buy one ticket, then once your Accessibility Request is approved, your companion ticket is issued free of charge. 
To apply for access facilities and essential companion tickets at Parklife, please follow these steps:

1. Buy a ticket for Parklife 2027.
2. Hold a valid Nimbus Access Card or Parklife Digital Access Pass.
3. Complete the Access Request Form through the parklife website.
4. Receive confirmation via email.

The Access Request Form and more information can also be found below. The deadline for submitting Access Requests is 4 weeks before the event.
If you have any queries or questions, please email access@parklife.com

info: Cabin for 2 includes: - Power supply (1 socket & 3 USB ports - for charging devices only) - Wooden stable door with lock - Wooden flooring - Canvas roof - Bed(s) with foam mattress - Pillows - Cotton bed linen - Bed throw - Bath towel per person - Internal and external LED Lights - Small mirror - 2 folding chairs - Bedside table Please note: Standing floor space is more limited when there is a double bed in this accommodation, as it occupies the majority of the floor space. The doors can be partially opened for ventilation and belongings can stored beneath the bed(s). Dimensions: 2m x 2m - Doors are 186cm high and 58cm wide - Doorway is 10cm above ground Accessibility Guidance: Accessible for some wheelchair users, please note the dimensions of the doorway.
pleaseNote: Over 18s only. PRICE DISPLAYED IS PER STRUCTURE NOT PER PERSON. Important! Festival Tickets are not included in the accommodation price and must be booked separately. Your Dreamfields experience will include: - Access to private Dreamfields campsite - Free car park pass (1 per 2 guests) - 24-hour Dreamfields reception & site security - Proper toilets & showers - Pamper tent with hairdryers and straighteners provided - Phone charging (at extra cost)

info: General Admission Only General Campervans/Caravans: Located behind the main general camping area, this is the largest Campervan/Caravan field. Front Row Campervans/Caravans: This field is next to Camping Plus right on the edge of the main festival. Kids' Garden Campervans/Caravans: Pitch up here and you'll be right next to the Lower Kids' Garden and just a short skip, hop and jump into the Castle Field and main stage (5 min walk). Max 3 adults & 4 children allowed per pitch in Front Row & Kids' Garden Campervan/Caravan fields. The 9 x 6 metre pitch allows room for your campervan/caravan, awning and your family tent. Pitches are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis and if you want to park next to friends, you will need to arrive together.
pleaseNote: **Does not include weekend camping tickets** Live-In Vehicle tickets are only valid with a Weekend festival entry ticket. Camp Bestival age restrictions: Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen Ticket (age 13-17) holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian.

info: Located in the heart of Camp Bestival's Slomo wellness area, Slomo Sanctuary offers a dedicated peaceful space where you can truly unwind. Step inside our beautifully designed Slomo garden... a calming haven designed for rest and renewal. Experience the powerful benefits of contrast therapy with exclusive access to our saunas, ice baths and hot tubs - a perfect balance of warmth and invigoration. Freshen up & recharge in our pamper lounge, complete with hot showers, changing rooms, beauty products & everything you need to feel festival-ready again. Come join us at Slomo Sanctuary - your moment of calm in the heart of the festival. Limited space available. Includes: - Saunas - Ice baths & cold drench showers - Hot Tubs - Hot Showers (Subject to availability) - Pamper lounge - Changing rooms - Posh toilets - Beauty products - Chill-out lounge **Tickets are refundable up to 1 month before the session** During peak hours, there may be waiting times.
pleaseNote: A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled.

info: Camping Plus is our unique initiative designed to give a bit of peace of mind to Camp Bestival-goers who want to make sure they've got a camping plot reserved, Camping Plus gives you a prime 5m x 7m pitch and has its own dedicated car park (included in ticket price) and entrance. Each plot is large enough for a family tent and all the kit you need when camping with kids. To make things even easier, when you go to book your Camping Plus plot, you can use our plot booking system - similar to when you book a theatre seat online - so you can choose exactly where you want to be in the Camping Plus field. Dimensions: Each plot is 5m (left to right) by 7m (top to bottom) 2 pitches lengthways will give you an area of 5m x 14m 2 pitches side by side will give you an area of 10m x 7m
pleaseNote: **Does not include weekend camping tickets** Camp Bestival age restrictions: Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen Ticket (age 13-17) holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Every effort is made to make your booked pitch available but the land can be affected by unforeseen circumstances on site and you may need to move to another pitch. No more than 2 adults can camp on any one pitch. If you have 3 adults, you will need another pitch. People staying outside Camping Plus cannot come into area. Please Note: Pitches in rows A-D are closer to the production road and thus may experience some traffic noise overnight with vehicles servicing toilets and other amenities.

info: By booking an Outward Adventures Activity Pass and taking part in or watching Bushcraft, Archery, or Paintball Target Practice, all participants acknowledge they do so entirely at their own risk, and the organisers, staff, volunteers, venue owners, and partners accept no liability for accidents, injuries, or loss of property except where required by law. Participants must follow all rules, safety instructions, and staff guidance, and organisers reserve the right to refuse access or remove anyone behaving unsafely or inappropriately. If you would like to participate with other families/friends, please make sure you are all booked onto the same Group and time slot. Timeslots each day run as follows: 9am - 11.25am, 12pm - 2.25pm, 3pm - 5.25pm Each time slot is split into 3 groups: Group 1: Birch, Group 2: Willow, Group 3: Oak See you in the clearing in the woods! A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled.
pleaseNote: All under 18s must be accompanied by an adult (either participating/non-participating) at the following ratio: 1 adult to 2 child/teen. If you are booking for more than 1 child/teen (age 8 - 17 yrs), they must all be booked in the same group so the accompanying adult can stay in the immediate vicinity. Participating adults must purchase a ticket in the same group as the child/teen(s) Non-participating adults do not need to pay & can simply relax and watch the fun on the sidelines. All accompanying adults must be present and visible at all times during the Outward Adventures experience. Yes you read that right. Participating adults! Adults can have fun too! Please wear comfortable loose-fitting clothing, jeans are fine but make sure they are loose, legging or joggers are ideal, T-shirts or hoodies would be great. Please wear enclosed shoes such as trainers. Please bring your own water bottle to keep hydrated.

info: Backstage Weekend Camping Upgrade includes: Private campsite for Backstage guests including: 12- hour Reception Free car parking a short walk from the campsite Campsite security through the weekend Food & Drinks vendors* Luxury Toilets Hot Showers Fast track entry from campsite to the main arena Access to Paradise Garden in the main arena including: Views of the main stage Food & Drinks vendors* Luxury Toilets Seating Booths available to book* *At extra cost Please select the adult backstage weekend camping ticket plus white car pass if you are planning to travel by car. Please note car park passes are NOT included in backstage camping accommodations bookings.
pleaseNote: Backstage Camping is open from 10am on Thursday 30th July until midday on Monday 3rd August 2026. There is a ticket limit of 20 tickets per person on this event. Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen/Child/Babe Ticket holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Proof of age may be required for all ticket types. Please ensure that you have ID with you in case you are asked. Failure to provide such ID may result in you being asked to leave the festival.

info: By booking an Outward Adventures Activity Pass and taking part in or watching Bushcraft, Archery, or Paintball Target Practice, all participants acknowledge they do so entirely at their own risk, and the organisers, staff, volunteers, venue owners, and partners accept no liability for accidents, injuries, or loss of property except where required by law. Participants must follow all rules, safety instructions, and staff guidance, and organisers reserve the right to refuse access or remove anyone behaving unsafely or inappropriately. If you would like to participate with other families/friends, please make sure you are all booked onto the same Group and time slot. Timeslots each day run as follows: 9am - 11.25am, 12pm - 2.25pm, 3pm - 5.25pm Each time slot is split into 3 groups: Group 1: Birch, Group 2: Willow, Group 3: Oak See you in the clearing in the woods! A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled.
pleaseNote: All under 18s must be accompanied by an adult (either participating/non-participating) at the following ratio: 1 adult to 2 child/teen. If you are booking for more than 1 child/teen (age 8 - 17 yrs), they must all be booked in the same group so the accompanying adult can stay in the immediate vicinity. Participating adults must purchase a ticket in the same group as the child/teen(s) Non-participating adults do not need to pay & can simply relax and watch the fun on the sidelines. All accompanying adults must be present and visible at all times during the Outward Adventures experience. Yes you read that right. Participating adults! Adults can have fun too! Please wear comfortable loose-fitting clothing, jeans are fine but make sure they are loose, legging or joggers are ideal, T-shirts or hoodies would be great. Please wear enclosed shoes such as trainers. Please bring your own water bottle to keep hydrated.

accessibility.info:
Attendees requiring accessibility support, including companion ticket requests where applicable, should complete the Accessibility Registration Form in advance.
Please buy your event ticket first. You will then need to apply for any accessible facilities you require.
Only buy a ticket for the customer who requires accessible facilities and any friends or family attending. You do not need to buy a ticket for your approved Essential Companion.
Essential Companion ticket requests will be processed as part of the accessible facilities application process.
 
For full details of the accessible facilities provided at the event, and the application process and form, please visit the accessibility section of the website: https://www.freedomstreeteu.com/accessibility

" Silver customers entering via the South entrance can purchase in advance

info: Join us for an incredible weekend, celebrating the very best of the 80's from Iconic musical legends, all set in the beautiful surroundings of Temple Island Meadows, Henley-On-Thames. For all the latest information answers to FAQs about Rewind South, please visit our helpful information page here >> https://south.rewindfestival.com/ If you can't find the answer you need, feel free to contact us at admin@rewindfestival.com
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Age restrictions: 18+ years require an ADULT ticket - those aged 10-17 years require a YOUTH ticket and must be with a guardian aged 21+ - children aged 0-9 years require a CHILD ticket. Please remember to bring identification to the festival if you appear under 18 and are coming to the festival without an over 21 year old, otherwise you may be denied entry to the event. Acceptable forms of identification are BLine cards, passports, driving licences and Citizenship cards. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option.

info: We no longer offer separate tickets for camping and non-camping. All tickets now include access to the festival and the freedom to come and go throughout the weekend. If you decide to camp later on, your ticket will still allow it - no need to make that decision now. Just be sure to keep your festival wristband on and arrive during the designated entry times. If you do decide to camp with us the campsite is located alongside the swimming and boating lakes, these campsites offer stunning views of the festival. Pitch your tent and enjoy the weekend. Quiet Camping - space in the quiet camping area of the general campsite is first-come, first-served. In this area, we request no sound systems; it is unsuitable for children under 8, and if you fancy a late-night party, please head back to the arena after 10pm (the unofficial curfew). Anyone 17 and under must have the appropriate ticket for their age.
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Anyone 17 and under must have the correct ticket for their age, and under 18s must be accompanied by a ticket-holding adult (18+) at all times. Bring proof of age to avoid issues. Tickets are non-transferable and only valid when purchased from official Festival Republic agents. Refunds are only considered for major cancellation, substantial alteration, or special exceptions determined by Wilderness Festival. Essential booking information will be emailed to the address providedcheck junk/spam folders and update your email with your ticket agent if it changes. Fixed Tier Pricing means the Event Organiser is selling tickets in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time - we recommend choosing the lower priced option.

info: Anyone 17 and under must have the appropriate ticket for their age. Under 18's must be accompanied by a ticket holding adult (18+) at all times. Don't take any chances - bring proof of age. Wilderness Festival 2026 - Sustainable Event gives fan a chance to either travel to the festival by cycling or travelling by coach. If you choose to cycle; Bridges for Music is hosting a chaperoned cycle ride from London to Wilderness. Riders will enjoy: Guided chaperoned Ride from London to the festival in Cornbury A warm on-site welcome with refreshments and music Support vehicle access and luggage drop at the festival Optional massage recovery sessions on arrival Access to food and drink tokens Click on the Big Green Coach tab for further information on our coach bundles which inlcude return transport from London Richmond and London Victoria.
pleaseNote: Under 17s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 10 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 10 will be cancelled. Ticketmaster are not selling Accessible tickets, these are being processed via Palace Bowl

Please buy your event ticket first (there is no separate accessible ticket). For full details of the accessible facilities provided at the event (including Essential Companion tickets) and the application process, please visit the accessibility section of the website: https://www.palacebowlpresents.co.uk/info-category/accessibility

Accessibility Information
Palace Bowl Presents strives to make the event accessible to all fans.
Accessible facilities at Palace Bowl Presents include:
" Essential Companion Ticket
" Accessible Toilet Facilities
" Raised Viewing Platform
" Ground Level Viewing Area
" Refrigerated Medication Storage
" Hearing Loops - Installed at the accessible check-in
" Accessible Parking
" Pick Up & Drop Off Passes

info: General Admission Only Saturday tickets include entry to the festival and allow entry on Saturday 1st August 2026 from 8:30am Proof of age may be required for all ticket types. Please ensure that you have ID with you in case you are asked. Failure to provide such ID may result in you being asked to leave the festival. Valid forms of ID include: - An in date photographic driver's license or provisional licence. - A valid passport (not a photocopy). Out of date passports will NOT be accepted. - A Proof of Age Standards Scheme Card (showing the PASS hologram).
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen Ticket (age 13-17) holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets if more than one price tier is on sale at the same time. A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled

info: General Admission Only Sunday tickets include entry to the festival and allow entry on Sunday 02nd August 2026 from 8:30am Proof of age may be required for all ticket types. Please ensure that you have ID with you in case you are asked. Failure to provide such ID may result in you being asked to leave the festival. Valid forms of ID include: - An in date photographic driver's license or provisional licence. - A valid passport (not a photocopy). Out of date passports will NOT be accepted. - A Proof of Age Standards Scheme Card (showing the PASS hologram).
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen Ticket (age 13-17) holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets if more than one price tier is on sale at the same time. A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled

info: General Admission Only Friday tickets include entry to the festival and allow entry on Friday 31st July 2026 from 8:30am Proof of age may be required for all ticket types. Please ensure that you have ID with you in case you are asked. Failure to provide such ID may result in you being asked to leave the festival. Valid forms of ID include: - An in date photographic driver's license or provisional licence. - A valid passport (not a photocopy). Out of date passports will NOT be accepted. - A Proof of Age Standards Scheme Card (showing the PASS hologram).
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen Ticket (age 13-17) holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time. A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled.

If you have purchased a Gold or Silver Camping ticket via resale or a Gold Day ticket via resale you will not be sent a parking hanger and you will need to purchase this separately. " Gold Camping customers entering via the Gold entrance can purchase a Gold car park pass on the day, just show your event ticket to the staff on arrival. " Silver customers entering via the South entrance can purchase in advance
pleaseNote: Over 18s only. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled. info: All weekend camping tickets include entry to the festival and access to the general campsites from Thursday 30th July to Monday 3rd August 2026. Proof of age may be required for all ticket types. Please ensure that you have ID with you in case you are asked. Failure to provide such ID may result in you being asked to leave the festival. Valid forms of ID include: - An in date photographic driver's license or provisional licence. - A valid passport (not a photocopy). Out of date passports will NOT be accepted. - A Proof of Age Standards Scheme Card (showing the PASS hologram).
pleaseNote: All ticket categories use fixed tier pricing. Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen Ticket (age 13-17) holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the Event Organiser is selling ticket in the same category at different prices - lower-priced tickets are released first, and when those sell out, higher-priced tickets will become available. There is no difference between these tickets. If more than one price tier is on sale at the same time. A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled.

info: Backstage Weekend Camping Ticket includes: Weekend Camping festival ticket Private campsite for Backstage guests including: 12- hour Reception Free car parking a short walk from the campsite Campsite security through the weekend Food & Drinks vendors* Luxury Toilets Hot Showers Fast track entry from campsite to the main arena Access to PayPal+ presents Paradise Garden in the main arena including: Views of the main stage Food & Drinks vendors* Luxury Toilets Seating Booths available to book* *At extra cost Please select the adult backstage weekend camping ticket plus white car pass if you are planning to travel by car. Please note car park passes are NOT included in backstage camping accommodations bookings. Proof of age may be required for all ticket types. Please ensure that you have ID with you in case you are asked. Failure to provide such ID may result in you being asked to leave the festival.
pleaseNote: All tickets categories use fixed tier pricing. Backstage Camping is open from 10am on Thursday 30th July until midday on Monday 3rd August 2026. There is a ticket limit of 20 tickets per person on this event. Each adult attending can accompany up to a maximum of 4 Teen/Child/Babe Ticket holders. All young persons aged 15-17 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 30 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the event organiser is selling tickets in the same category at different prices - lower priced tickets are relased first & when those sell out, higher priced tickets will be available. There is no difference between these tickets.

All young persons aged 10-14 MUST be accompanied by an adult over the age of 26 - MUST be the parent, legal guardian or nominated guardian. Fixed tier pricing means the event organiser is selling tickets in the same category at different prices - lower priced tickets are relased first & when those sell out, higher priced tickets will be available. There is no difference between these tickets. A max of 20 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 20 will be cancelled.

JANUARY BLUES FESTIVAL 2027 presents
KING KING
+ SPECIAL GUESTS: TBC
DJ: SNOWBOY
The January Blues Festival celebrates it's 10th anniversary year with the welcome return of Scottish Blues-Rock group King King.

Scottish Blues-Rock group King King formed in 2008. It may well have been high profile support slots with the likes of John Mayall's Bluesbreakers, Thunder and Europe which opened King King's music up to a much wider audience. But it was pure talent and hard work which got them there in the first place.

King King have released five studio and two live albums since 2011. At the 2014 British Blues Awards, King King won five awards including the 'Best Band' and 'Best Album' Awards. They swiftly followed this up by winning several awards at the British Blues Awards in 2016 including 'Best Album' for their studio LP Reaching For The Light.
Host and DJ for the January Blues Festival is Snowboy playing Chicago Blues, Rhythm & Blues, Blues Rock and more.

 This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

description:
AGMP Presents
JANUARY BLUES FESTIVAL 2027 presents
ERIC BIBB
+ special guests: TBC
The January Blues Festival celebrates it's 10th anniversary year with the welcome return of bluesman Eric Bibb.
With a career spanning five decades, over forty albums, three Grammy nominations, a multitude of Blues Foundation awards and countless more accolades, Eric Bibb has secured his legacy as a legendary figure in the blues and roots genre.
Born into a lineage of activism, Eric's father, the late Leon Bibb, was a key figure in the civil rights movement, marching alongside Dr. Martin Luther King. Immersed in the Village folk scene during his youth, Eric Bibb found inspiration in the visits of luminaries like Bob Dylan, Joan Baez, and Pete Seeger. Influenced deeply by the sounds of Odetta, Richie Havens, and Taj Mahal, he synthesized these elements into a style uniquely his own.
Beyond conventional genres, Eric Bibb is labeled a bluesman, but he defies categorization, seamlessly sliding between musical realms. Grounded in the folk and blues tradition with contemporary sensibilities, Bibb's music reflects his thoughts on current world events and his own lived experiences, whilst remaining entertaining, uplifting, inspirational and relevant.
Bibb's catalogue is now over 40 albums strong. His 2024 album In The Real World, recorded at Peter Gabriel's Real World Studios received critical acclaim. 
Eric Bibb is more than a blues troubadour; he is a storyteller and philosopher. His legacy is not just in the notes he plays or the stages he graces but in the questions he poses and the hope he instills.

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

 Under 16s accompanied by an adult 

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

U14s accompanied by an adult, and 14+ otherwise

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (Under 14s must have adult supervision)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (under 18 must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ Show but under 18 must leave after 11pm even accompanied by an adult

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

18+ SHOW

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ Show but under 18 must leave after 11pm even accompanied by an adult

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - this is Tribute Show performed by the same musicians + Stuart Rook and Eddie Anderson on vocals. Eddie Anderson will perform the Oasis songs. All 5 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show.

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (under 18s must be accompanied)
Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....
This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.
“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X
“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1
"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley
THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS
THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.
HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint
Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

-------------
 
Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.
- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show
