description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"8 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)
Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs + Kooks + Fontaines D.C....
This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 5th year.
“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X
“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1
"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley
THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS + KOOKY KOOKS + FONTAINES D.C
THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER, KAISER CHEATS, KOOKY KOOKS and FONTAINES D.C are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.
HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint
Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

 
Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Kooky Kooks, 5th Fontaines y.c, 6th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 7th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL
"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"
14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)
Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....
This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.
“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X
“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1
"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley
THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS
THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.
HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza
Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

 
Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.
- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - some bands share members, from a pool of 8 musicians with Stuart Rook, Eddy Andersen and Louis Suttle Marshall on vocals. All 6 acts perform all of this music all over the UK as the individual, separate acts - they are distinct acts - which coming together for this special-length Indiepalooza Show

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

18+ No ID No Entry

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials
Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

- ---------
N.B - As per the videos below (please check them out) - this is Tribute Show performed by the same musicians + Stuart Rook and Eddie Anderson on vocals. Eddie Anderson will perform the Oasis songs. description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 4th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU chose the anthems!"

14+ show (14-16s must be accompanied)

Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Sam Fender, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in it’s 5th year.

“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X

“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1

"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SCAM FENDER + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, SCAM FENDER and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.

HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza

Websites - http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://scamfender.com // http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials

Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Scam Fender, 3rd Kasabiain’t, 4th Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 5th Oasis 96, and then Kopycat Killers closing the night.

description:
INDIEPALOOZA FESTIVAL

"6 Tribute Bands, 1 Night, YOU choose the anthems!"
Indiepalooza is an amazing touring indie-rock tribute festival featuring leading tributes to (ALL on ONE night!) :-
Sam Fender, The Killers, Arctic Monkeys, Oasis, Kasabian + Kaiser Chiefs....

Fresh from serenading all the Newcastle United players at the Wembley Carabao Cup Final afterparty!!
This indoor show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and is in its 4th year.
“This. Is. Great. He is selling out all over the UK!” - Chris Moyles, Radio X
“This is Great. He does sound great to be fair!” - Greg James, Radio 1
"The BEST tribute band I've ever seen, and I've shot HUNDREDS" - Duncan Cowley
SCAM FENDER + THE KOPYCAT KILLERS + SUBARCTIC MONKEYS + OASIS 96 + KASABIAINT + KAISER CHEATS

This is the ULTIMATE indoor festival - with world-leading tributes to the Sam Fender, Killers, Oasis, Arctic Monkeys, Kasabian and Kaiser (as well as wall to wall indie BANGERS from DJ 505)......all on ONE night. This show has sold out 1000 cap+ venues all over the country and in its 4th year at O2 City Hall Newcastle.

SCAM FENDER, THE KOPYCAT KILLERS, SUBARCTIC MONKEYS, OASIS 96, KASABIAN'T, and KAISER CHEATS are amongst the best tributes in the world, playing huge festivals both in the UK and abroad to thousands, and now ALL COMING TOGETHER on this special touring festival show.
HOURS OF WALL TO WALL BANGERS ALL NIGHT!!! - Expect Mr Brightside, Don’t Look Back In Anger, I Predict A Riot, Fire, Seventeen Going Under, I Bet That You Look Good On The Dancefloor, Hypersonic Missiles, Somebody Told Me, Wonderwall, Ruby, Mardy Bum, Human, When You Were Young, Club Foot, Will We Talk?, Do I Wanna Know, Supersonic, All These Things That I’ve Done, She’s Electric, Why’d You Only Call Me When You’re High, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Read My Mind, Florescent Adolescent, Glamorous Indie Rock N Roll, R U Mine?, Smile Like You Mean It, Spit Of You, 505, Getting Started, Snap Out Of It, People Watching, Oh My God! and many more!

Instagram - http://instagram.com/scamfender// http://instagram.com/thekopycatkillerstribute // http://instagram.com/subarcticmonkeystribute // http://instagram.com/oasis96tribute // https://instagram.com/kasabiaint // https://www.instagram.com/indiepalooza
Websites - http://scamfender.com // http://thekopycatkillers.com// http://subarcticmonkeys.com // https://www.indiepalooza.co.uk

-- "I've booked tribute in LA for years, this is the best of the best" - Steve Ochs
-- "I've seen Killers 50 times in 9 countries, I was blown away by this tribute" - V.Moran

Hundreds more testimonials - http://thekopycatkillers.com/testimonials
8+ Show
----------------------------------

 
Typical running orders are sets of 20-60 minutes depending on billing, and depending on door time and curfew - in this order 1st Kaiser Cheats, 2nd Kasabiain’t, 3rd Sub-Arctic Monkeys, 4th Oasis 96, 5th Kopycat Killers and then Scam Fender closing the night.
- ---------

description: Grammy Award-winning reggae legends Inner Circle have been spreading the spirit of Jamaican music worldwide for over 55 years.Founded in 1968 in Kingston by brothers Ian and Roger Lewis, the band rose to global prominence with iconic hits such as “Bad Boys” — the theme for the long-running TV series COPS and blockbuster movies Bad Boys I & II — and “Sweat (A La La La La Long)”, both accumulating over 1.5 billion views on YouTube.Inner Circle’s high-energy live shows take audiences on a journey from Jamaica’s roots in the ’60s and ’70s to multi-platinum hits and modern classics like “Young, Wild & Free” and the 2015 hit remix of “Tenement Yard” with Chronixx. Their performances have graced the world’s biggest festivals, sharing stages with legends like Elton John, Peter Gabriel, Van Morrison, Jimmy Page, Robert Plant, Carlos Santana, and many more.With a discography spanning 20+ studio albums, a Grammy Award, multiple IRAWMA honors, and a world-renowned recording studio in Miami, Inner Circle continues to innovate, collaborate with rising stars, and deliver reggae with universal appeal. Their ongoing tours and festival appearances reaffirm their place as ambassadors of Jamaican music and culture, uniting generations through rhythm, positivity, and family.

description:
Following last summer’s momentous sold-out edition, Anjunadeep Open Air returns to the stunning Old Royal Naval College on Sunday, August 9. We can’t wait to come back to this breathtaking UNESCO World Heritage Site for another special afternoon on the Thames.

Expect an all-star lineup of Anjunadeep artists, performing in the stunning grounds of the twin-domed landmark, with the riverside offering the perfect backdrop as the sun sets over London. Your afternoon will be complete with local food vendors, fully-stocked bars, bespoke merch and more.

VIP ticket holders will enjoy exclusive access to the Painted Hall and balcony on one of the college wings, offering uninterrupted views of the main stage and the River Thames. The Painted Hall itself is a masterpiece, featuring more than 3,700 square metres of Baroque walls and ceilings. Additional perks include premium food and drink options, an exclusive chillout area and dedicated toilets.

description:
DAY (3PM - 10.30PM): Dance at Two Tribes Brewery’s open air venue, Campfire.

NIGHT (10:30PM - 3AM): The party continues up the road at our historic home, The Jazz Cafe.

---

This summer, Soul City takes over Camden for three special day & night sessions, starting in the open air before continuing late into the night at our long-time home, Jazz Cafe.

We’ll begin the day at Campfire, Two Tribes Brewery’s outdoor venue, where the sound system will carry warm house grooves and dancefloor favourites across the courtyard from mid-afternoon through sunset. As night falls, we’ll move just around the corner to Jazz Cafe, where the energetic Soul City dancefloor carries on until the early hours.

Expect that unmistakable London summer feeling: cold drinks, good people and loud music under open skies.

----------

Both venues are 18+. Tickets start at £10 for the day & night - and as always £5 for the night party only.

Please adhere to specified entry times on your ticket to avoid potential late surcharge. Last entry to the day party is 8pm and night party is at 2am. Tickets are always available on the door for both parties, but the price is higher than advance tickets.
